{{Top|leg}}
'''Qellrin''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While near [[Q'mara]], Qellrin's [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] armed with [[Firespray DL-87 stun rifle|Firespray DL-87]] deck-clearing blasters. By setting up [[portable shield generator]]s, Qellrin's crew countered the weapon and managed to turn the tables on their attackers.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
